# Abhieshwari Solar

> M/s Abhieshwari Enterprises and Developers ("Abhieshwari Solar") is a rooftop solar panel installation business serving Gorakhpur and nearby areas in Uttar Pradesh, India. Services cover residential, commercial, shop, office and factory installations, including free site visits and end-to-end government subsidy paperwork (PM Surya Ghar + UPNEDA state top-up, net metering, DISCOM coordination).

Contact: +91 90265 73953 · info@abhieshwarisolar.in
Address: EWS-41, Janpriya Vihar Colony, Humayunpur North, Gorakhnath, Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, 273015
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919026573953

## Guides

- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy: The Complete Process](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-pm-surya-ghar-subsidy.html): Eligibility, subsidy amounts (up to ₹1,08,000 combined), and the 7-step registration-to-disbursement process for Uttar Pradesh homeowners.
- [How Rooftop Solar Actually Works](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-how-solar-works.html): Panels, inverters and net metering explained end to end.
- [Choosing the Right System Size](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-choosing-system-size.html): How roof area, electricity bill and venue type determine 2kW vs 10kW sizing.
- [Solar Maintenance for Gorakhpur's Climate](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-solar-maintenance.html): Cleaning schedules, monsoon precautions, inverter upkeep, warranty coverage.
- [Reading Your Electricity Bill & Solar Payback](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-electricity-bill-payback.html): How to read a UPPCL bill and calculate solar payback period.
- [How Much Does Solar Cost in Gorakhpur?](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-solar-cost-gorakhpur.html): Typical price per kW before and after subsidy, and what changes the price.
- [Commercial Solar ROI](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-commercial-solar-roi.html): Why solar often pays back faster for shops, offices and factories than homes.
- [How to Choose a Solar Installer](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-choosing-installer.html): What to check before hiring, empanelment, warranty terms, red flags.
- [Common Solar Myths & Mistakes](https://abhieshwarisolar.in/guide-solar-myths.html): Myth-vs-fact answers to the most common misconceptions.
